contract.classification: arbitrary integer-sample timing-offset stress in a synthetic dimensionless software test; no physical channel claim
contract.protocol_status: v5 exploratory fixed integer-sample timing-offset sweep; conditions frozen in source before full run; not a formal preregistration or physical validation
contract.preservation: signed encoder and all v1-v4 sources, tests, reports, and result artifacts are used without modification

noise_model.name: iid_gaussian_sample_noise_on_finite_guarded_stream
noise_model.construction: seeded NumPy normal draws over each complete zero-guarded serialized waveform; both receivers use the same noisy stream

timing_offset_model.name: constant_integer_sample_receiver_window_offset
timing_offset_model.offset_sign_convention: positive means receiver windows start late; negative means they start early
timing_offset_model.sample_rate_offset: none; the integer timing phase remains constant for every symbol; no clock-rate drift or interpolation is modeled
timing_offset_model.waveform_serialization: concatenate the existing 64-sample encoder segments in frame order, then prepend/append 64 zero-valued guard samples; no pulse shaping or other waveform change
timing_offset_model.receiver_window_rule: nominal decoder uses [guard + k*64 + offset, guard + k*64 + offset + 63]; guard padding makes early/late frame-edge samples defined and prevents circular wrap
timing_offset_model.oracle_window_rule: timing-aware oracle knows the exact fixed offset and extracts the true nominal windows [guard + k*64, guard + k*64 + 63]
timing_offset_model.level_basis: small discrete sample-offset stress grid selected for this software test only; no measured timing channel or hardware specification

decoder_methods.existing_nominal_decoder: unchanged digital_to_wave.decode_wave applied to windows shifted by the declared integer offset; it receives no timing correction
decoder_methods.oracle_exact_timing: analysis-only upper-bound reference supplied the exact offset and frame boundary; it reselects the true symbol windows, then uses the unchanged nominal projection; not a timing-recovery implementation
decoder_methods.weak_zero_output_floor: always returns zeros; recorded once against each fixed vector; ignores the received waveform and is not a competing decoder

contract.frame_pass_rule: inclusive: all 32 absolute component errors must be <= 0.25
contract.seed_streams: NumPy SeedSequence([master_seed, offset_index, vector_index]); paired receiver methods share each complete noisy stream

analytic_calibration.projection_noise: each 64-sample receiver window has independent IID noise and q dot q=32, so the decoded noise SD is sigma/sqrt(32)
analytic_calibration.nominal_bias: computed exactly by applying the unchanged projection to the clean, zero-guarded stream at the shifted window indices; adjacent-symbol and guard samples are included
analytic_calibration.oracle_bias: numerical roundoff only; true segment windows are reselected using exact timing knowledge
analytic_calibration.frame_probability: product over 32 disjoint component windows of P(-0.25 <= Normal(bias_k,sigma/sqrt(32)) <= 0.25); at sigma=0 use the deterministic inclusive pass rule
analytic_calibration.pooled_probability: equal-weight mean of the six fixed-pattern theoretical frame probabilities; pooled Wilson interval is conditional on this vector panel

source_basis.relevance: documents timing synchronization as correction of receiver symbol-timing clock skew and demonstrates fixed timing error
communications textbook treatment of symbol-timing synchronization and timing recovery
distinguishes sample-clock offset from carrier-frequency offset and describes timing recovery

metric_definitions.frame_pass_share: passing frames divided by frames; pass iff every absolute component error is <= 0.25
metric_definitions.confidence_interval: two-sided 95% Wilson score interval for Monte Carlo pass shares; deterministic clean/floor rows have no interval
metric_definitions.uncertainty_scope: intervals quantify IID simulation variation conditional on the six fixed vectors and stipulated synthetic model, not model or physical uncertainty
metric_definitions.component_errors: empirical MAE, RMSE, mean signed error, and population variance over decoded components

results.uncertainty_kind: two-sided 95% Wilson interval; conditional on fixed vector panel and synthetic IID draws
